query: California West Nile virus cases 2024 CDPH surveillance weekly report August
query_rationale: Directly targets the California Department of Public Health (CDPH) WNV surveillance reporting page, which publishes weekly cumulative case counts, deaths, and county-level breakdowns during the transmission season. August 2024 data would appear in weekly updates published during or shortly after that month. This is the single highest-yield source for all target fields.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDPH West Nile virus surveillance page or weekly activity report with cumulative and weekly case counts by county
expected_trust_signal: cdph.ca.gov domain; official state public health agency; cites ArboNET or state lab-confirmed data

query: CDC West Nile virus 2024 California cases deaths ArboNET statistics
query_rationale: Targets CDC's ArboNET-based WNV surveillance data for 2024, which aggregates state-reported figures including California. CDC publishes cumulative national and state-level WNV case counts, neuroinvasive vs. non-neuroinvasive breakdowns, and deaths. This provides cross-validation against CDPH figures and may include data through August 2024.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC WNV disease cases and deaths reported to CDC by state, 2024 provisional data table
expected_trust_signal: cdc.gov domain; federal public health authority; ArboNET surveillance system

query: West Nile virus California county August 2024 cases deaths public health department report
query_rationale: Targets county-level public health department reports for California counties with historically high WNV burden (Los Angeles, Sacramento, Kern, Fresno, Riverside, San Bernardino). County health departments often publish their own WNV updates with locality-level detail not captured in state summaries, enabling population of the 'locality' field. The broader query without rigid quoting increases recall across multiple county agency sites.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: County public health department WNV press release, advisory, or surveillance update citing case counts for August 2024
expected_trust_signal: County .gov or .ca.gov domain; official county health officer or epidemiologist attribution

query: West Nile virus California August 2024 cases deaths outbreak news
query_rationale: News media reports published in August 2024 frequently cite official CDPH or county health department figures and can provide dated evidence quotes, locality detail, and links to primary official sources. This query uses natural language without rigid quoting to maximize recall across news outlets covering California WNV activity during the target window.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: News article from August 2024 citing official WNV case counts, deaths, or hospitalizations in California with attribution to CDPH or county health
expected_trust_signal: Publication date within August 2024; cites named official source (CDPH, county health officer); includes specific numeric case counts

query: westnile.ca.gov Arbobulletin 2024 August weekly report human cases deaths site:westnile.ca.gov
query_rationale: Directly targets the westnile.ca.gov Arbobulletin weekly PDF series for August 2024. The CDPH WNV bulletin numbering system runs approximately weekly; August 2024 corresponds to bulletins roughly #30–#35 of the 2024 season. A site-restricted query with 'August' and '2024' should surface the specific bulletin PDFs with week-ending dates in August 2024, enabling confirmation of the time window and extraction of case counts, deaths, and county breakdowns.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: westnile.ca.gov Arbobulletin PDF for a week ending in August 2024, with human case counts by county, cumulative season totals, deaths, and neuroinvasive disease classification
expected_trust_signal: westnile.ca.gov domain; CDPH Vector-Borne Disease Section authorship; bulletin number and week-ending date in PDF title or header

query: CDC West Nile virus 2024 historical data cases deaths by state California neuroinvasive
query_rationale: The iteration 1 CDC query returned the 2026 current-year page rather than the 2024 historical data table. CDC maintains a separate 'Historical Data' page for prior years (e.g., cdc.gov/west-nile-virus/data-maps/historic-data.html) with state-level WNV case counts, neuroinvasive/non-neuroinvasive breakdowns, and deaths for 2024. This query uses 'historical data' and '2024' to target that specific page and avoid the current-year redirect.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC WNV historical data table for 2024 showing California case counts (neuroinvasive, non-neuroinvasive), deaths, and provisional totals by state
expected_trust_signal: cdc.gov domain; ArboNET data attribution; 2024 provisional or final data label

query: Los Angeles County Sacramento County West Nile virus cases August 2024 public health advisory deaths
query_rationale: Los Angeles and Sacramento counties are historically the highest-burden California counties for WNV. The iteration 1 county query was broad; this query focuses specifically on these two high-priority counties with 'August 2024' and 'advisory' to surface county health department press releases or advisories published during the target window. The lacounty.gov result appeared in iteration 1 but its content was not confirmed for August 2024 dates or numeric data.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: LA County DPH or Sacramento County DHHS press release or advisory from August 2024 citing WNV case counts, deaths, or hospitalizations with specific dates
expected_trust_signal: lacounty.gov or saccounty.gov domain; county health officer or epidemiologist attribution; publication date in August 2024

query: California West Nile virus death hospitalization neuroinvasive disease August 2024 report
query_rationale: Deaths and hospitalizations are the most underrepresented target fields from iteration 1. This query specifically adds 'death', 'hospitalization', and 'neuroinvasive disease' terms to surface news articles or official reports from August 2024 that report fatalities or severe disease outcomes in California. Neuroinvasive disease (encephalitis, meningitis, acute flaccid paralysis) is the CDC/CDPH classification for severe WNV and is the category most likely to include hospitalization and death data.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: News article or official report from August 2024 citing WNV deaths, hospitalizations, or neuroinvasive disease cases in California with specific counts and attribution to CDPH or county health
expected_trust_signal: Publication date within August 2024; cites named official source; includes specific numeric death or hospitalization counts
